review.method: Viewed 160px native cells without resampling, using common per-ROI transforms.
review.main: No visible added texture in sky. Coarse fence crossings, soft cables and leaf textures agree.
review.mesh: Both priors, two native ROIs and both display gains viewed with both camera JPEGs and ISO100 AHD. Mottled nominal left and clearest incomplete right transferred crossings across paths.
review.outliers: Small numeric contrasts at train lamps, platform strip and saturated magenta sign. Shapes and color look alike at display x1.
review.exact: Window bars agree with soft masonry. In the clipped cyclist all paths reproduce a too-yellow background relative to the exact target.
